_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, net-to-gross, expense, receivables and operating-margin signals with Visa's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that connects consumers, businesses, financial institutions and governments around the world to fast, secure and reliable electronic payments.' 'Our business is affected by overall economic conditions and consumer spending.' 'Within the general purpose payment card industry, we face substantial and intense competition worldwide in the provision of payments services to financial institution clients and their cardholder merchants.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (the economy and spending are a 'why', not the company's own label: the LOW, SHW and JPM reading), so the kind is DURABLE; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a payments network on these dates, so the watch list is empty

classification.quality_note: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that connects consumers, businesses, financial institutions and governments around the world to fast, secure and reliable electronic payments.' 'Our business is affected by overall economic conditions and consumer spending.' 'Within the general purpose payment card industry, we face substantial and intense competition worldwide in the provision of payments services to financial institution clients and their cardholder merchants.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (the economy and spending are a 'why', not the company's own label: the LOW, SHW and JPM reading), so the kind is DURABLE; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a payments network on these dates, so the watch list is empty. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.94x; +82% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.00; conservative 2yr +5%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY09-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +18.7%/yr (Q4 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 4.2-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +26.0%/yr (FY09-FY12 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY12, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: V (retrospective, 2012-12-14) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.94x (37.1% downside to Bear $92.38 / +39.4% upside to Bull $204.67) | Adj composite 1.81 vs market 2.81: gap -1.00 [OVERVALUED] | +82% above the EPP floor $80.60 (13x FY13E $6.20) | Conservative 2-yr case: +5.3% total (+2.7%/yr) | At 23.7x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $194.17 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue +14.6% YoY in Q4 FY12, forward revenues +14.6% (Q4 FY12 revenue growth (no FY13 revenue range)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
